channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: PGR quer que a PF ouça Flávio em investigação por calúnia contra Lula
item.description: The Attorney General's Office requested the Federal Police to reopen the investigation against Senator Flávio Bolsonaro for defamation against President Lula, stating he was not formally heard. The PF had concluded that his X post falsely attributed drug trafficking, money laundering, and terrorism support to Lula, constituting a crime against honor.

item.title: Alckmin pode aumentar presença em SP para ajudar Haddad a diminuir vantagem de Tarcísio
item.description: Fernando Haddad’s pre-campaign team acknowledges the need to increase Geraldo Alckmin’s presence in São Paulo, especially in the interior, to narrow Tarcísio de Freitas’s lead, who holds 46% versus Haddad’s 30% in a Datafolha poll. The goal is to close the gap to force a runoff and use the state campaign as a platform to support Lula’s 2026 re-election, while also capitalizing on potential weaknesses of Flávio Bolsonaro.

item.title: Lula faz mudanças na equipe de comunicação do governo para reforçar pré-campanha
item.description: Photographer Ricardo Stuckert was dismissed from the government's Secretariat of Social Communication to coordinate social media for Lula's 2026 re-election pre-campaign. Three other Secom officials will also leave government this week to join the campaign team, including director Raquel Sepúlveda and aides Gustavo Couto and Gilberto Santos, who will handle press relations. The changes come ahead of candidate formalization, with the PT planning to officially launch Lula's candidacy at a convention on August 2 in São Paulo.

item.title: PGR pede que STF insista na notificação de Silvio Almeida em caso de importunação sexual
item.description: The Attorney General's Office requested the STF to persist in notifying Silvio Almeida, former Minister of Human Rights, at new addresses in São Paulo, after the 5th Federal Vara failed to locate him. He is accused of sexual importuning by Anielle Franco, former Minister of Racial Equality, based on PF testimonies and Me Too NGO reports. Minister André Mendonça, the rapporteur, demanded explanations for the lack of defense from the accused.

item.title: Dólar cai a R$ 5,13 com mercado de olho em discurso de Flávio nos EUA
item.description: The dollar fell to R$ 5,13 and the Ibovespa dropped 0,93% as investors awaited a speech by pre-candidate Flávio Bolsonaro at the USTR in Washington regarding potential 25% additional tariffs on Brazilian exports to the U.S. The Boletim Focus showed a slight improvement in 2026 inflation forecasts, down from 5,33% to 5,30%, while oil prices declined after Opec+ announced a production increase effective August 2026.

item.title: “Lula é o único que quer a tarifa”, diz Flávio
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) claimed that President Lula (PT) wants the United States to impose a 25% tariff on Brazilian goods starting July 15. He argued the measure would benefit Lula by enabling a 'false narrative' to justify domestic policies. The statement was made on social media and reported by O Antagonista.

item.title: O sinal que acendeu o alerta no Planalto a dias do prazo final do tarifaço do governo Trump
item.description: The Lula government views the prospects of reversing the U.S. 25% tariff on Brazilian goods as low, citing Washington's unwillingness to negotiate and political bias. Despite the deadlock, the government continues diplomatic dialogue and will not send representatives to the USTR public hearing on July 15, where Senator Flávio Bolsonaro is expected to attend as a presidential pre-candidate.

item.title: Damares Alves agradece Marina Silva por mensagem de solidariedade após ataques misóginos: 'Somos irmãs em Cristo'
item.description: Senator Damares Alves thanked former Environment Minister Marina Silva for a message of solidarity after suffering misogynistic attacks, including death threats against her indigenous daughter. Damares emphasized that, despite being on opposite political sides, they share evangelical faith and a past of fighting for a better Brazil. Marina had previously condemned misogyny in public debate, advocating for civility and respect despite political differences.

item.title: Paulo Figueiredo desiste de ir com Flávio Bolsonaro em audiência sobre o tarifaço
item.description: Influencer Paulo Figueiredo said he will not attend the public hearing with the U.S. government regarding the 25% tariff on Brazilian goods, choosing instead to submit written comments to avoid distracting from Flávio Bolsonaro’s leadership in opposing the tariffs. His absence follows a controversial remark claiming women 'vote poorly,' which caused embarrassment to Flávio’s campaign and prompted a public disavowal by the senator. The hearing, which began Monday, includes Lula administration officials and industry representatives seeking to negotiate a reduction of the Trump-imposed tariff, with Brazil’s Pix payment system also on the agenda.

item.title: A nova pesquisa Gerp sobre a disputa pela Presidência da República
item.description: The Gerp institute will release a new presidential voting intention poll next Wednesday with 2,000 interviews and a 2.24 percentage point margin of error. The survey will test likely first-round scenarios featuring Lula (PT) and Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), as well as alternatives like Michelle Bolsonaro (PL) and Geraldo Alckmin (PSB) in their places, and update second-round intentions. The poll is commissioned by the Association of Radio and Television Broadcasters of São Paulo State.

item.title: Motta cria comissão especial para analisar PEC que reduz maioridade penal para 16 anos
item.description: House Speaker Hugo Motta has established a special committee to analyze a constitutional amendment that would lower the age of criminal responsibility from 18 to 16, following its approval in the Constitution and Justice Committee. The proposal, backed by the opposition and opposed by the Lula government, would allow 16- and 17-year-olds to be tried as adults, with additional proposals suggesting criminal liability as early as age 12 for serious crimes.

item.title: Procuradora investigada por desvios se diz vítima de perseguição no Paraná
item.description: Labor prosecutor Margaret Matos de Carvalho, removed from office and charged by the STJ with allegedly diverting R$ 7.1 million in agreements with Itaú Bank, denies wrongdoing and claims she is a victim of political persecution by members of the Paraná MPF linked to Operation Lava-Jato. She says she opposed the '10 measures against corruption' and participated in a show of support for President Lula while he was imprisoned, which she believes provoked retaliation. Margaret argues the MPT reports contain no proof of financial diversion and that the questioned formalities lacked binding regulations at the time of the expenditures (2013-2016).

item.title: Flávio diz que ida aos EUA ajuda empresas e nega atrapalhar acordo
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro defends his visit to the U.S. as an effort to protect Brazilian interests amid the U.S. tariff threat, rejecting claims that his actions undermine Lula’s government negotiations. He states he is in Washington to present technical and political arguments against the proposed tariffs, including defending the Pix payment system, and blames President Lula for the trade crisis.

item.title: PGR defende ouvir Flávio Bolsonaro em ação sobre calúnia contra Lula
item.description: The PGR urged the STF to have Senator Flávio Bolsonaro heard by the PF in the inquiry investigating alleged slander against President Lula, stating the hearing is relevant for a possible retraction, which, if made fully before sentencing, could exempt him from penalty under the Penal Code. Both are pre-candidates for the 2026 presidency. The PF had already concluded in June that Bolsonaro slandered Lula in a January social media post linking the president to Nicolás Maduro and accusing him of drug trafficking, money laundering, and election fraud.

item.title: Itamaraty diz que equiparação de PCC e CV como terroristas dos EUA causa ‘risco de uso da força’
item.description: Brazil's Foreign Ministry warned that the U.S. designation of PCC and CV as terrorist groups could risk triggering U.S. military force against Brazil, alongside economic and sovereignty impacts, with no tangible benefits for international cooperation on organized crime. The government stated the unilateral measure could justify extraterritorial U.S. actions in financial, migration, and penal domains, even against Brazilians with no direct ties to the groups. The U.S. decision, backed by Flávio Bolsonaro, was made without prior consultation and had already been viewed by the Lula administration as a potential prelude to military action on Brazilian soil.

item.title: PGR pede que inquérito contra Flávio Bolsonaro por calúnia contra Lula volte à PF
item.description: The PGR requested that the investigation against Flávio Bolsonaro for alleged slander against President Lula be returned to the Federal Police for his testimony, after the PF concluded he committed the crime. The testimony is considered relevant due to the possibility of retraction, which may exempt from penalty in slander and defamation cases. The case stems from a January post by Flávio linking Lula to crimes following Maduro's capture by the U.S.

item.title: Por que o governo Lula enviou observadores na audiência do tarifaço
item.description: The Lula government sent observers from Itamaraty to monitor the USTR hearings on the tariff increase, a standard procedure since 2025. The move aims to listen to civil society and track statements, including that of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, who registered to speak against the tariffs. The Planalto is not officially participating, as it maintains direct dialogue with the U.S. on the matter.

item.title: PGR defende que PF ouça Flávio em investigação por suposta calúnia contra Lula
item.description: The Attorney General's Office argued that the Federal Police should hear Senator Flávio Bolsonaro in an investigation into alleged slander against President Lula. The request is based on a January post where the senator linked Lula to Venezuelan dictator Nicolás Maduro following Maduro's capture. The PGR considers the testimony necessary to clarify the facts and assess whether the crime of slander occurred.

item.title: Tarifaço: nos EUA, Flávio diz que vai "reverter o estrago" de Lula
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro, a pre-candidate for president, participated in a U.S. public hearing on a potential 25% tariff on Brazilian goods, accusing Lula of causing 'damage' he intends to reverse. The senator spoke for five minutes at the USTR, addressing accusations on digital trade, electronic payments, and unfair preferential tariffs for Mexico and India.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro pode dificultar negociação entre Brasil e EUA sobre tarifas, diz professor da FGV
item.description: The participation of Senator Flávio Bolsonaro and influencer Paulo Figueiredo in U.S. public hearings on potential tariffs against Brazilian products may hinder Brazil-U.S. trade negotiations, as their involvement could be seen as an attempt to interfere in Brazil’s electoral agenda, according to FGV political scientist Marco Antonio Teixeira. He argues that trade talks should be managed exclusively by Itamaraty and diplomatic channels, free from domestic political disputes, and notes that past actions by Bolsonaro allies to pressure Brazilian authorities increase the likelihood that this engagement will be viewed as politically motivated rather than constructive.

item.title: Ramagem diz que extradição ‘não acontecerá’ e que voltará ao Brasil se Flávio Bolsonaro for eleito
item.description: Alexandre Ramagem, former head of Brazil's intelligence agency Abin, convicted in the coup plot and fugitive in the U.S., stated his extradition to Brazil will not happen and that he will return only if Flávio Bolsonaro is elected president in 2027. He accused Brazil of attempting to deport him irregularly and said he is awaiting a decision on his political asylum request in the United States.

item.title: Ramagem nega conhecer bicheiro suspeito de chefiar “máfia do cigarro”
item.description: Former federal deputy Alexandre Ramagem denied knowing Adilson Oliveira Coutinho Filho, aka Adilsinho, a suspected leader of the 'cigarette mafia' in Rio de Janeiro, stating his name was wrongly included in a list found by the Federal Police during Operation Unha and Carne. Ramagem claimed political persecution, referencing his Supreme Court conviction, U.S. immigration arrest, and ongoing asylum request. The operation, now in its fifth phase, probes links between public officials and criminal organizations, including illicit payments and money laundering.

item.title: Votação de Tarcisio pode impactar campanha de Lula
item.description: A strong victory for Tarcisio de Freitas in São Paulo could significantly boost Flavio Bolsonaro's campaign and harm Lula's candidacy, given the state's decisive role in Brazilian presidential elections. If internal divisions on the right are resolved, Tarcisio could campaign in other states during the runoff, strengthening the opposition and leaving Lula without strategic support in São Paulo.

item.title: PL faz nova tentativa para pacificar relação entre Michelle Bolsonaro e Flávio
item.description: A longtime ally of Michelle Bolsonaro has been working to broker a truce between her and Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, urging him to get closer to his stepmother during visits to Jair Bolsonaro and to apologize. The effort, supported by PL members, aims to ease family tensions within the Bolsonaro circle ahead of the 2026 elections.

item.title: PGR pede depoimento de Flávio Bolsonaro por calúnia contra Lula
item.description: The Attorney General's Office requested that the Federal Police take testimony from Senator Flávio Bolsonaro over alleged defamation against President Lula, after the PF concluded he linked the president to drug and arms trafficking, money laundering, and election fraud in a social media post. The request was sent to Supreme Court Justice Alexandre de Moraes, who will decide whether to grant it.

item.title: Lula não consegue convencer os entregadores de jeito nenhum
item.description: The Lula government has failed to make progress in its negotiations with app-based delivery workers, despite outreach efforts including the appointment of Guilherme Boulos to the Presidency's General Secretariat. The workers remain dissatisfied with stagnant pay and poor working conditions. The administration's strategy to engage the sector has not yielded the expected results so far.

item.title: Lula paga recorde de R$ 34 bilhões em emendas antes das eleições e irriga campanha de parlamentares
item.description: The Lula government paid R$ 33.89 billion in parliamentary amendments by July 4, 2026, the highest amount in history for a pre-election period, surpassing the full 2022 total and Novo PAC investments in the same timeframe. This early disbursement, enabled by legislative changes since 2019 (including the 'emenda Pix' and a prioritized payment calendar), allows funds to be used during the electoral campaign, despite the electoral blackout that bans such transfers three months before voting, except for ongoing works or calamity situations. While the government claims compliance with legislation and STF rulings, experts argue this distorts electoral law.

item.title: As pautas que Janja deve trabalhar para tentar garantir reeleição de Lula
item.description: First Lady Janja Lula da Silva is preparing a political agenda focused on women and religious groups, especially evangelicals, to strengthen President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's 2026 re-election campaign. She has already engaged with Catholic and evangelical circles, including publicly criticizing Bolsonarist allies like Pastor Silas Malafaia, while facing growing resistance from women and religious sectors due to the Bolsonaro family's backlash. Janja is expected to travel across the country, appear in campaign videos, and possibly lead her own structure within the PT campaign office.

item.title: Motta decide avançar com redução de maioridade penal e cria comissão para discutir matéria
item.description: House Speaker Hugo Motta announced the creation of a special committee to discuss a constitutional amendment reducing the age of criminal responsibility from 18 to 16, despite not being required to do so. The proposal, previously approved by the Constitution and Justice Committee in June, will now be debated separately from the Public Security PEC following pressure from the government base, which labeled it electoral populism. Motta stated he does not intend to conclude the analysis before the October 2026 elections.

item.title: Pressionado pela oposição, Motta cria comissão especial da PEC da redução da maioridade penal
item.description: House Speaker Hugo Motta established a special committee to debate the PEC on reducing the age of criminal responsibility following pressure from the opposition and allies who had advised delaying the measure due to the electoral context. The decision came after a Datafolha poll showed 79% public support for lowering the age of criminal responsibility, intensifying calls for public debate. Previously, Motta had kept the proposal on hold.

item.title: Crusoé: Eduardo Bolsonaro exalta “confiança” de Neymar
item.description: Eduardo Bolsonaro praised the confidence shown by Neymar Jr. during the penalty kick against Norway, when the player responded boldly to the Norwegian goalkeeper who predicted the ball would hit the post. The incident occurred while Brazil was trailing 2-0 in the match.

item.title: PSOL quer esvaziar discurso de Flávio Bolsonaro sobre o pix
item.description: Federal deputy Duda Salabert (PSOL-MG) proposed awarding the National Order of Merit to Banco Central employees responsible for creating Pix, in response to criticisms by Flávio Bolsonaro. The initiative aims to recognize Brazil’s technological innovation and counter political narratives questioning Pix’s security or origins.

item.title: Nova lei cria primeira universidade federal dedicada ao esporte
item.description: President Lula signed Law 15.457/26, establishing the Federal University of Sport (UFEsporte), the first federal higher education institution exclusively dedicated to sport, with headquarters in Brasília. The university aims to train professionals for sports management, train athletes, promote inclusion in parasports, and ensure education for athletes in transition or dual careers, alongside gender and racial equity initiatives.

item.title: Governo: decisão dos EUA sobre PCC e CV não traz benefícios concretos
item.description: The Brazilian government states that the U.S. designation of PCC and CV as terrorist organizations brings no concrete benefits and could lead to unilateral American measures, including potential military action in Brazil. Itamaraty warns of financial, migratory, and penal risks for Brazilian citizens, emphasizing the defense of national sovereignty.

item.title: Senador bolsonarista usa festa junina para associar PT a "quadrilha"
item.description: Senator Jorge Seif (PL-SC) shared a WhatsApp story featuring a June festival-themed image associating the PT with the term 'quadrilha' (gang), implying the party is linked to organized crime. The post was made on July 2 and remained visible in Stories. In June, Supreme Court Minister André Mendonça had already ordered the removal of similar content posted by deputy Sóstenes Cavalcante (PL-RJ).

item.title: Defesa de Lulinha aciona PF e tenta arquivar inquérito por ‘falta de justa causa’ antes das eleições
item.description: The defense of Fabio Luis Lula da Silva (Lulinha) plans to request the dismissal of the PF investigation into alleged INSS discount frauds, citing lack of just cause, and aims to act before the 2026 elections to avoid damaging President Lula’s campaign. Lawyers Marco Aurélio Carvalho and Guilherme Suguimori are set to meet with PF Director-General Andrei Passos before filing a habeas corpus. Although the PF indicated that analysis of Lulinha’s data will only occur in 2027 due to prioritization of detainees and those under restrictive measures, the defense denies attempting to 'jump the queue' and asserts there is no basis to maintain the investigation.

item.title: Dossiê sobre tarifas e Pix enviado ao governo Trump amplia desgaste de Flávio Bolsonaro entre eleitores decisivos, aponta pesquisa
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro sent an 86-page dossier to the U.S. government requesting a 180-day suspension of tariffs on Brazilian products until after the 2026 elections, which provoked a negative reaction among swing voters. According to the Instituto Democracia em Xeque, the PL pre-candidate is losing trust and narrative autonomy among this decisive voter segment.

item.title: Dino e Moraes dão 48 horas para tribunais explicarem pagamentos a magistrados
item.description: Supreme Court ministers Alexandre de Moraes and Flávio Dino ordered the presidents of six state Courts of Justice to explain, within 48 hours, payments made to active, retired, and pensioner judges between April and July 2026, following a report that at least seven state tribunals circumvented the Court’s limits on 'penduricalhos'. The ruling requires individualized breakdowns of remunerative and indemnity payments, plus copies of payroll slips, to verify compliance with the March STF decision capping such bonuses at 35% of ministers’ salaries. The move aims to prevent payments exceeding the functional ceiling—up to 78,000 reais—as the 2026 elections approach.

item.title: A nova pesquisa Ideia para testar o desempenho de Michelle Bolsonaro
item.description: The Ideia Institute will release a poll with 1,500 interviews (margin of error: 2.5 pp) assessing Michelle Bolsonaro’s presidential prospects in 2026. The survey will test scenarios with and without Flávio Bolsonaro, including a hypothetical runoff against Lula, and evaluate voter reactions to Michelle’s video criticizing her stepson.

item.title: Indústria teme que atuação de Flávio nos EUA dificulte negociação sobre tarifas
item.description: National industry representatives express concern over Senator Flávio Bolsonaro's (PL-RJ) participation in U.S. hearings regarding proposed increases in import tariffs on Brazilian goods. His presence and potential statements could complicate ongoing trade negotiations, as his stance is seen as potentially conflicting with sectoral interests.

item.title: Eliminação do Brasil na Copa muda retorno do Brasileirão? Veja quando o campeonato volta
item.description: Brazil's World Cup elimination does not change the Brasileirão Série A schedule, which resumes on July 16, three days before the World Cup final. The CBF maintained its pre-planned calendar to minimize disruption, with the 19th round set for July 16, featuring matches like Botafogo vs Santos and Vitória vs Vasco. The resumption occurs while the World Cup is still ongoing, allowing clubs without international players to continue and concluding the first round before the tournament's end.

item.title: Como Flávio, Eduardo e mais aliados de Bolsonaro associaram a derrota da seleção brasileira a Lula
item.description: Bolsonaro allies, including Flávio and Eduardo Bolsonaro, linked Brazil's World Cup loss to Lula's government, using social media to turn sports frustration into political gain. They posted messages tying the team's title drought to PT governments, shared montages of Bolsonaro holding the trophy, and held live streams, while other PL deputies referenced PT electoral numbers and judicial decisions to politicize the outcome. The strategy was described as an attempt to capitalize on public dissatisfaction amid high polarization.

item.title: Famosos que comemoraram derrota de Neymar e Brasil na Copa
item.description: Following Brazil's 2-1 loss to Norway in the 2026 World Cup, numerous celebrities took to social media to express a range of reactions, including sorrow, support for the players, criticism of Neymar, and celebration of his retirement. Figures such as Ary Fontoura, Adriane Galisteu, Simaria, João Gomes, Luciano Huck, Maísa Silva, Zé Felipe, Erika Januza, and Luana Piovani commented on the result, highlighting collective frustration and debates over the team’s performance and Neymar’s role.

item.title: Direita dá tiro no pé ao focar impeachment do STF, povão quer fim da 6x1, diz nova líder de Lula no Senado
item.description: The new Lula government leader in the Senate, Teresa Leitão (PT-PE), claims the right is making a strategic mistake by focusing on impeaching Supreme Court ministers in the 2026 Senate campaign. She argues that ending the 6x1 work schedule will be an electoral advantage for the left, even if the PEC is not approved before the elections.

item.title: Cenário em SP aumenta peso eleitoral de Tarcísio na eleição presidencial
item.description: The possibility of Tarcísio de Freitas winning the São Paulo gubernatorial election in the first round increases his electoral weight in the 2026 presidential race, according to leaders from Lula’s and Flávio Bolsonaro’s camps. While Bolsonaro allies see him as key to defeating Lula, PT allies believe he may remain passive ('corpo mole') to position himself for 2030, especially given his proposed PEC to ban presidential re-election. Datafolha shows Tarcísio with 46% of voting intentions but 52% of valid votes — enough to win in the first round within the margin of error.

item.title: Suspense de Michelle Bolsonaro amplia crise no PL em um momento de definição
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro's Senate candidacy for the Federal District remains uncertain following public conflicts with Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, prompting her to consider withdrawing. PL leaders, including Damares Alves and Celina Leão, are working to convince her to stay in the race, viewing her as a key vote-getter for the party. July will be decisive, with party conventions beginning on July 20.

item.title: STF nega pedido da Assembleia do Paraná e cassação de Renato Freitas segue suspensa
item.description: Supreme Court Justice Edson Fachin denied a petition from the Paraná Legislative Assembly and kept suspended the vote on the cassation request against state deputy Renato Freitas (PT-PR), accused of parliamentary misconduct following a street fight in November 2025. The decision is monocratic and awaits validation by the full STF plenary, while the Alep stated it will appeal for the case to be reviewed by the entire Court. The process remains under seal, with Freitas claiming political persecution despite the Ethics Committee’s recommendation for cassation.

item.title: Vote no gol mais bonito da fase de 16 avos
item.description: The article features five goals selected by commentators of VEJA's 'Bola na Copa' program as the most beautiful from the round of 16 of the 2026 World Cup. Candidates include Gabriel Martinelli (Brazil), Kylian Mbappé (France), Ismaïla Sarr (Senegal), Gonçalo Ramos (Portugal), and Sidny Cabral (Cabo Verde). Each goal is described with details of the play, match context, and image, emphasizing technique, creativity, and visual impact. The public is invited to vote for the most beautiful goal of the stage.

item.title: Ibovespa cai com início de negociações do tarifaço
item.description: The Ibovespa fell 1.21% on Monday as investors monitored the start of U.S.-Brazil trade talks over potential tariffs of up to 37.5% on Brazilian goods, citing concerns over PIX, deforestation, piracy, and alleged slave labor conditions. The CNI projects that 4,187 Brazilian products, worth $14.9 billion in exports, could be affected. Markets are also awaiting the FOMC minutes and Brazilian inflation data, while the 2026 IPCA forecast was slightly lowered to 5.30%.

item.title: Cinco minutos para argumentação, perguntas e registro oficial: como funcionará a audiência nos EUA que ouvirá Flávio Bolsonaro
item.description: Senator Flávio Bolsonaro (PL-RJ) will testify on Tuesday in a USTR public hearing regarding a potential 25% tariff on Brazilian goods, following his submission of an 86-page document requesting tariff suspension and exclusion of Pix from the trade dispute. He argues the tariff would politically strengthen Lula and advocates for targeted sanctions against individuals instead of broad economic measures. Brazil did not send official representatives, viewing the hearing as private-sector focused, while maintaining parallel diplomatic negotiations.
